name: Burning Secrets
source: College was just a week away…until someone robbed your house and took a shot at you! Find out who’s attacking your family, discover who you really are, and maybe meet a few girls along the way!
translation: 距离大学开学只剩最后一周……谁知竟有歹徒闯入你家洗劫，甚至还朝你开了一枪！查明究竟是谁在袭击你的家人，揭开你自己的真实身世，说不定一路上还能邂逅几位可爱的女孩子！
